==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*ser- (guard)}}
From {{der|en|fro|reserver}}, from {{der|en|la|reservō|t=to reserve, retain}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈzɝv/|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Knabrupt-reserve.wav|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈzɜːv/|a=RP}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɜː(ɹ)v|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|re|serve}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# A [[restriction]].
## The act of reserving or keeping back; [[reservation]]; [[exception]].
##: {{ux|en|The book is '''on reserve'''.}}
##: {{ux|en|I accept your view with one '''reserve'''.}} <!--eh? "reservation", surely-->
## [[restraint|Restraint]] of freedom in words or actions; [[backwardness]]; [[caution]] in personal behavior.
# That which is reserved or kept back, as for future use.
## A natural [[resource]] known to exist but not currently exploited.
##: {{ux|en|New oil '''reserves''' are continuously being discovered, but not as fast as the existing ones are running out.}}
##* {{quote-journal|en|date=2014-04-25|author=[http://www.theguardian.com/profile/martin-lukacs Martin Lukacs]
|volume=190|issue=20|page=13|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.theguardian.com/environment/2014/apr/16/canada-becoming-launch-pad-of-a-global-tar-sands-and-oil-shale-frenzy Canada becoming launch-pad of a global tar sands and oil shale frenzy]
|passage=If Alberta’s '''reserves''' are a carbon bomb, this global expansion of tar sands and oil shale exploitation amounts to an escalating emissions arms race, the unlocking of a subterranean cache of weapons of mass ecological destruction.}}
## A tract of land reserved, or set apart, for a particular purpose
##: {{ux|en|the Connecticut '''Reserve''' in Ohio was originally set apart for the school fund of Connecticut.}}
##: {{ux|en|the Clergy '''Reserves''' in Canada are for the support of the clergy.}}
## {{senseid|en|Q57237926}} {{lb|en|Canada}} A [[tract]] of [[land]] set apart for the use of an [[Aboriginal]] [[group]]: Indian reserve.
##: {{alti|en|res<id:Q57237926>|rez<id:Q57237926><qq:clippings>}}
##: {{syn|en|reservation<id:Q57237926><qq:US>}}
## {{lb|en|military}} A body of troops kept in the rear of an army drawn up for battle, reserved to support the other lines as occasion may require; a force or body of troops kept for an [[exigency]].
##: {{coi|en|no '''reserves''' ''[the military force is throwing everything it has at the front]''}}
## {{lb|en|finance|insurance}} Funds kept on hand to meet planned or unplanned financial requirements.
##* {{RQ:Time|url=https://time.com/7339685/person-of-the-year-2025-ai-architects/|date=11 December 2025|author=Charlie Campbell, Andrew R. Chow and Billy Perrigo|title=The Architects of AI Are TIME’s 2025 Person of the Year|passage=The tone was set at Trump’s Inauguration. Tech moguls streamed into Washington; some sat behind the President during his Inaugural Address, a signal of the power they would wield. Over the next 11 months, they would use their enormous cash '''reserves''', cultural power, and momentum to push their products into homes across the world.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260928075844/https://time.com/7339685/person-of-the-year-2025-ai-architects/|archivedate=28 September 2026}}
## A [[reserve price]] in an [[auction]].
##: {{coi|en|no '''reserve''' ''[the lot(s) will be sold no matter how low the bids are]''}}
##: {{coi|en|'''reserve''' not met ''[the lot(s) will not be sold because the highest bid was too low to be acceptable]''}}
## [[wine|Wine]] held back and [[age]]d before being sold.
## {{lb|en|ceramics}} Absence of color or decoration; the state of being left [[plain]].
##* {{quote-book|en|year=1973|author=Charles Kyrle Wilkinson|publisher=Metropolitan Museum of Art|location=New York, N.Y|title=Nishapur: Pottery of the Early Islamic Period|page=161
|passage=Each is decorated with a simple disk in '''reserve''' and a band in '''reserve''' adorned with white dots.}}
# Something initially kept back for later use in [[recreation]].
## {{lb|en|sports}} A member of a team who does not participate from the start of the game, but can be used to replace tired or injured team-mates.
## {{lb|en|card games}} A group or pile of cards dealt out at the beginning of a [[patience]] or [[solitaire]] game to be used during play.
# In [[exhibitions]], a [[distinction]] indicating that the recipient will get a [[prize]] in the event of another person being disqualified.
# {{lb|en|calico printing}} A [[resist]].
# A [[preparation]] used on an object being [[electroplate]]d to [[fix]] the limits of the [[deposit]].

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To keep [[back#Adverb|back]]; to [[retain]].
#: {{syn|en|hold}}
#: {{ux|en|We '''reserve''' the right to make modifications.}}
#: {{ux|en|I will '''reserve''' judgment until I have actually read his book.}}
#: {{ux|en|I '''reserve''' the right to change my mind.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|ditransitive}}
## To [[keep]] in store for future or special use.
##: {{syn|en|hold#Verb|save#Verb}}
##: {{ux|en|This cake is '''reserved''' for the guests!|q=transitive}}
##: {{ux|en|Please '''reserve''' me a parking space if you can.|q=ditransitive}}
##* '''c. 1703-1720''', {{w|Jonathan Swift}}, ''A Letter to a Very Young Lady on Her Marriage''
##*: {{ux|en|Conceal your esteem and love in your own breast, and '''reserve''' your kind looks and language for private hours.}}
## To [[book#Verb|book]] in advance; to make a [[reservation]] for.
##: {{syn|en|sign up for|register for|schedule#Verb|enroll in|book#Verb}}
##: {{ux|en|I '''reserved''' a table for us at the best restaurant in town.|q=transitive}}
##: {{ux|en|Thanks for '''reserving''' us a room!|q=ditransitive}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|obsolete}} To make an [[exception]] of; to [[except#Verb|except]].
